preference_reason: The rejected turn bundles two tool calls, fabricates the <tool_response> observation inside the assistant turn, and declares the suite green on invented evidence; the chosen turn emits one template-derived call and ends the turn so the runtime can answer - the protocol stated in the input.
evidence: The input states one tool call per turn with a runtime-provided <tool_response>; the rejected text contains a model-authored <tool_response> and '2 passed' that no turn observed, while the chosen text contains no observation strings.

verification.expected: Chosen ends after one derived tool_call span with no observation text; rejected contains multiple spans plus a fabricated <tool_response>

failure_mode: Fabricating tool observations inside assistant turns and batching multiple calls against a one-action-per-turn runtime
